title: 第十八章 你试试
content_zh:
陈木现在之所以没有动手将这群歹徒制服，陈木是想看看这群歹徒准备做什么，同样陈木想知道这群歹徒后面是不是有人指使，如果有人指使那么就算陈木将这群歹徒制服了，同样不能避免第二次的绑架的发生。

    不过陈木也不怕这群人会对苏林依不利，就在这群歹徒上车的一瞬间，陈木就已经给苏林依两女释放了一个防御法术，一旦这群歹徒攻击苏林依两女，那么攻击将会自动反弹。

    “你们是谁？你们绑架苏林依有什么目的？”陈木见到自己的防御法术都施加好了，便淡淡的对着旁边开车的歹徒说道。

    “小子，闭嘴，我让你说话了吗？再说一句，老子崩了你！”开车的歹徒十分凶狠的对着陈木道，他没想到这小子竟然敢说话，要知道以前自己绑架别人，一般都是蜷在那里不敢动才对啊，没想到今天遇到个不怕死的。

    “呵，我不信你能崩了我，不怕告诉你，我刚刚已经偷偷报了警了，你们逃不掉的，如果你们放了我们，警察还能从轻发落。”陈木叹了口气，对着这群歹徒说道。

    “哈哈！”开车的歹徒像是听到什么笑话一般，大笑了起来，车上的其他几名歹徒同样大笑了起来。

    “小子，既然你敢报警，你今天也别想活了，不过在你死之前，我让你死的瞑目一些，别说警察根本抓不住我们，等他们找到我们的时候，我们早就离开了华夏了！”开车的歹徒拿出手枪对着陈木，阴狠的说道。

    同一时间

    唐大生早就报警，此刻警察局接到报案，自然知道了这桩绑架案的重要性，立刻调集了人手，全城封锁，准备追击歹徒，营救苏林依。

    宁华市的警察局自然知道苏林依是谁，华宇医药公司总裁苏本的女儿，苏本无论财力还是社会地位在宁华市都是首屈一指，他的女儿被绑架，这事可就大了。

    此刻杨环嘉眉头紧皱，她没想到她刚被调派到宁华市，刚上任副队长，就遇到了这么棘手的案件。

    “杨队，我是在您小队担任小组长的王一中，我们刚刚在摄像头下已经发现了歹徒绑架苏林依的车辆，请下一步指示。”

    “你们立刻乔装跟上那辆车，记住，不能让歹徒发现。”杨环嘉没想到手底下人办事效率挺高的，立刻吩咐道
content_en:
The reason why Chen Mu did not take action to subdue this group of gangsters now is that Chen Mu wanted to see what these gangsters were planning to do. Chen Mu also wanted to know if there was someone behind these gangsters who was instigating them. If someone was instigating them, even if Chen Mu subdued these gangsters, the second kidnapping would not be avoided.

However, Chen Mu was not afraid that this group of people would be detrimental to Su Linyi. The moment the gangsters got on the car, Chen Mu had already released a defensive spell on the two girls Su Linyi. Once the gangsters attacked the two girls Su Linyi, the attack would automatically rebound.

"Who are you? What is your purpose in kidnapping Su Linyi?" Chen Mu said calmly to the gangster driving next to him when he saw that his defensive spells were all applied.

"Boy, shut up, did I let you speak? Say it again, I will kill you!" The gangster driving the car said to Chen Mu very fiercely. He did not expect that this boy dared to speak. You must know that in the past, when I kidnapped others, I usually just huddled there and did not dare to move. I didn't expect to meet someone who was not afraid of death today.

"Ha, I don't believe you can kill me. I'm not afraid to tell you. I just secretly called the police. You can't escape. If you let us go, the police can give you a lighter sentence." Chen Mu sighed and said to the group of gangsters.

"Haha!" The gangster who was driving laughed as if he heard some joke, and several other gangsters in the car also laughed.

"Boy, since you dare to call the police, you won't be able to live today. But before you die, I will let you die in peace. Don't say that the police can't catch us. By the time they find us, we will have already left China!" The gangster who drove the car took out his pistol and pointed it at Chen Mu, saying viciously.

at the same time

Tang Dasheng had called the police a long time ago. When the police station received the report, it naturally knew the importance of the kidnapping case. It immediately mobilized manpower and locked down the entire city, preparing to chase the gangsters and rescue Su Linyi.

The police station in Ninghua City naturally knew who Su Linyi was. She was the daughter of Su Ben, the president of Huayu Pharmaceutical Company. Su Ben was the best in Ninghua City in terms of financial resources and social status. If his daughter was kidnapped, this would be a big deal.

At this moment, Yang Huanjia frowned. She did not expect that she would encounter such a difficult case just after she was transferred to Ninghua City and became the deputy captain.

"Team Yang, I am Wang Yizhong, the team leader of your team. We have just discovered the vehicle in which the gangsters kidnapped Su Linyi under the camera. Please give us the next step."
